title: sarcandra glabra f. flava
intro: Sarcandra glabra f. flava, commonly known as the yellow sarcandra, is a plant species that belongs to the family Hernandiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting antitumor activity. The bioactive constituents of Sarcandra glabra f. flava include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
